Actually, I think the goal is to position all 3 entities so that each collects its matching colored dots. The entities need to be at:

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Continue moving orange X: DOWN x6, RIGHT x6
actions = ['DOWN'] * 6 + ['RIGHT'] * 6
result = action(actions)

seg = current_frame.segmentation
containers = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'c' and n['pixels'] == 8]
print(f"Containers remaining: {len(containers)}")
for c in containers:
    b = c['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    print(f"  at ({(min(rows)+max(rows))//2}, {(min(cols)+max(cols))//2})")

# Find orange X center
orange_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'O']
if orange_nodes:
    all_orange = []
    for n in orange_nodes:
        for p in n['boundary']:
            all_orange.append(p)
    rows = [p[0] for p in all_orange]
    cols = [p[1] for p in all_orange]
    print(f"Orange X: center~({(min(rows)+max(rows))//2}, {(min(cols)+max(cols))//2})")

# Find red diamond center
red_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'r' and n['pixels'] > 10]
if red_nodes:
    all_red = []
    for n in red_nodes:
        for p in n['boundary']:
            all_red.append(p)
    rows = [p[0] for p in all_red]
    cols = [p[1] for p in all_red]
    print(f"Red diamond: center~({(min(rows)+max(rows))//2}, {(min(cols)+max(cols))//2})")

print(f"Score: {last_action_result.get('score')}")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
